questions.question: Please list the codes of the schools with a total enrollment of over 500.
questions.evidence: Total enrollment can be represented by `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.CDSCode FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` + T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

questions.question: Which school in Contra Costa has the highest number of test takers?
questions.SQL: SELECT sname FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' AND sname IS NOT NULL ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Name schools in Riverside which the average of average math score for SAT is grater than 400, what is the funding type of these schools?
questions.evidence: Average of average math = sum(average math scores) / count(schools).
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.sname, T2.`Charter Funding Type` FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`District Name` LIKE 'Riverside%' GROUP BY T1.sname, T2.`Charter Funding Type` HAVING CAST(SUM(T1.AvgScrMath) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.cds) > 400

questions.question: What is the average math score of the school with the lowest average score for all subjects, and in which county is it located?
questions.evidence: Average score for all subjects can be computed by AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.AvgScrMath, T2.County FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL ORDER BY T1.AvgScrMath + T1.AvgScrRead + T1.AvgScrWrite ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Please specify all of the schools and their related mailing zip codes that are under Avetik Atoian's administration.
questions.SQL: SELECT School, MailZip FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND AdmLName1 = 'Atoian'

questions.question: What is the total number of non-chartered schools in the county of Los Angeles with a percent (%) of eligible free meals for grades 1 through 12 that is less than 0.18%?
questions.evidence: non-chartered schools refer to schools whose Charter = 0; K-12 means grades 1 through 12; percent of eligible free rate for K-12 = `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / `Enrollment (K-12)`
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T2.School) FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Los Angeles' AND T2.Charter = 0 AND CAST(T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) * 100 / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18

questions.question: What is the educational level name for the schools with Breakfast Provision 2 in county code 37? Indicate the name of the school.
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.EILName, T2.School FROM frpm AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Breakfast Provision 2' AND T1.`County Code` = 37

questions.question: How many atoms with iodine and with sulfur type elements are there in single bond molecules?
questions.evidence: with iodine element refer to element = 'i'; with sulfur element refers to element = 's'; single type bond refers to bond_type = '-'; Should consider the distinct atoms when counting;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'i' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS iodine_nums , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 's' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS sulfur_nums FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '-'

questions.question: Identify all the atoms that are connected to the atoms of the TR181 molecule.
questions.evidence: TR181 molecule refers to molecule_id = 'TR181'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T2.atom_id = T1.atom_id WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR181'

questions.question: Of all the carcinogenic molecules, which one has the most double bonds?

questions.SQL: SELECT T.molecule_id FROM ( SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.label = '+' AND T1.bond_type = '=' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(T1.bond_type) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T

questions.question: Does bond id TR001_1_8 have both element of chlorine and carbon?

questions.SQL: SELECT T2.bond_id, T2.atom_id2, T1.element AS flag_have_CaCl FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T2.atom_id = T1.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8' AND (T1.element = 'c1' OR T1.element = 'c')

questions.question: What is the percentage of element chlorine in carcinogenic molecules?

questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT( CASE WHEN T1.element = 'cl' THEN T1.element ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.element) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'

questions.question: Among all the posts posted by the most influential user, identify the percentage with a score above 50.

questions.question: Which top 20 driver created the shortest lap time ever record in a Formula_1 race? Please give them full names.
questions.evidence: shortest lap time refers to MIN(time); the time format for the shortest lap time is 'MM:SS.mmm' or 'M:SS.mmm'; full name of the driver refers to forename, surname
questions.SQL: WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (SELECT driverId, (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, ':') + 1, INSTR(time, '.') - INSTR(time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(time, INSTR(time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000 ELSE 0 END) AS time_in_seconds FROM lapTimes) SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname, T1.driverId FROM (SELECT driverId, MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds FROM lap_times_in_seconds GROUP BY driverId) AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId ORDER BY T1.min_time_in_seconds ASC LIMIT 20

questions.question: What was the position of the circuits during Lewis Hamilton's fastest lap in a Formula_1 race?

questions.SQL: SELECT T1.position FROM lapTimes AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 on T1.driverId = T2.driverId WHERE T2.forename = 'Lewis' AND T2.surname = 'Hamilton' ORDER BY T1.time ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: List the top 10 players' names whose heights are above 180 in descending order of average heading accuracy.

questions.SQL: SELECT t1.player_name FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.height > 180 GROUP BY t1.id ORDER BY CAST(SUM(t2.heading_accuracy) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.`player_fifa_api_id`) DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question:
What is the difference of the average ball control score between Abdou Diallo and Aaron Appindangoye
?
questions.evidence: difference of the average ball control = SUBTRACT(AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'), AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye')); AVG(ball_control WHERE player_name = 'XX XX') = SUM(CASE WHEN player_name = 'XX XX' THEN ball_control ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN player_name = 'XX XX' THEN id ELSE NULL END)
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.ball_control ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo' THEN t2.id ELSE NULL END) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.ball_control ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye' THEN t2.id ELSE NULL END) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id

questions.question: Give the name of the league had the most matches in the 2008/2009 season?
questions.evidence: league that had the most matches in the 2008/2009 season refers to MAX(league_name WHERE season = '2008/2009');
questions.SQL: SELECT t1.name FROM League AS t1 JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.league_id WHERE t2.season = '2008/2009' GROUP BY t1.name HAVING COUNT(t2.id) = (SELECT MAX(match_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(t2.id) AS match_count FROM Match AS t2 WHERE t2.season = '2008/2009' GROUP BY t2.league_id))

questions.question: For the team "Hannover 96", what was its defence aggression class on 2015/9/10?
questions.evidence: "Hannover 96" refers to team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'; on 2015/9/10 refers to date LIKE '2015-09-10%';
questions.SQL: SELECT t2.chanceCreationShootingClass FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t1.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96' AND t2.`date` LIKE '2015-09-10%'

questions.question: What are the player api id of 10 heaviest players?
questions.evidence: heaviest refers to MAX(weight)
questions.SQL: SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: List down the long name for slow speed class team.
questions.evidence: slow speed class refers to buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow'; long name refers to team_long_name
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT t1.team_long_name FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow'

questions.question: Does the KSV Cercle Brugge team have a slow, balanced or fast speed class?
questions.evidence: KSV Cercle Brugge refers to team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'; speed class refers to buildUpPlaySpeedClass
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT t1.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team_Attributes AS t1 INNER JOIN Team AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t2.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'

questions.question: In the 2015–2016 season, how many games were played in the Italian Serie A league?
questions.evidence: In the 2015–2016 season refers to season = '2015/2016'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(t2.id) FROM League AS t1 INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.league_id WHERE t1.name = 'Italy Serie A' AND t2.season = '2015/2016'

questions.question: What is the percentage of female patient had total protein not within the normal range?
questions.evidence: female refers to sex = 'F'; total protein not within the normal range refers to TP < '6.0' or TP > '8.5'; calculation = DIVIDE((ID where sex = 'F' and TP < '6.0' or TP > '8.5'), COUNT(ID)) * 100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' AND (T2.TP < 6.0 OR T2.TP > 8.5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'

questions.question: How many patients hadn't undergone a medical examination until at least a year following their initial hospital visit?
questions.evidence: hadn't undergone a medical examination until at least a year refers to SUBTRACT(year(`Examination Date`), year(`First Date`)) > = 1
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '+' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) >= 1

questions.question: For the patient whose birthday was 1959/3/1, what symptoms did he/she have during the examination on 1993/9/27?
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.Symptoms FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Birthday = '1959-03-01' AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993-09-27'

questions.question: How many female patients born in 1964 were admitted to the hospital? List them by ID.
questions.evidence: female refers to SEX = 'F'; born in 1964 refers to YEAR(Birthday) = 1964; admitted to the hospital refers to Admission = '+'
questions.SQL: SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) = '1964' AND SEX = 'F' AND Admission = '+'

questions.question: What is the average age of the male patient with high cholesterol?
questions.evidence: average age = DIVIDE(SUM(SUBTRACT(YEAR(NOW()), YEAR(birthday))), COUNT(ID)); male patient refers to sex = 'M'; high cholesterol refers to `T-CHO` > = 250;
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(STRFTIME('%Y', date('NOW')) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`T-CHO` >= 250 AND T1.SEX = 'M'

questions.question: For the patients with an abnormal activated partial prothrom bin time, how many of them does not have thrombosis?
questions.evidence: abnormal activated partial prothrom bin time refers to APTT > 45; does not have thrombosis refers to Thrombosis = 0; Only count ones without repetitive.
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE T3.Thrombosis = 0 AND T2.APTT > 45

questions.question: How many patients born after 1980/1/1 have an abnormal fibrinogen level?
questions.evidence: born after 1980/1/1 refers to Birthday > '1980-01-01'; normal fibrinogen level refers to FG between 150 and 450; Should return the number of distinct patients.
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450 AND T1.Birthday > '1980-01-01'

questions.question: What is the anti Cardiolipin antibody concentration of the female patient with the highest uric acid level in the normal range?
questions.evidence: anti Cardiolipin antibody concentration refers to `aCL IgG`, `aCL IgM`, `aCL IgA`; female patient refers to Sex = F'; highest uric acid level in the normal range refers to MAX(UA > 6.50);
questions.SQL: SELECT T3.`aCL IgG`, T3.`aCL IgM`, T3.`aCL IgA` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T3.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA > 6.5 ORDER BY T2.UA DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the patients whose total bilirubin is over the normal range, how many of them have a peripheral pattern observed in the sheet of ANA examination?
questions.evidence: total bilirubin is over the normal range refers to `T-BIL` > = 2.0; peripheral pattern is observed in the sheet of ANA examination refers to that ANA Pattern contains 'P';
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.`T-BIL` >= 2 AND T3.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%'

questions.question: Among the patients whose total cholesterol is within the normal range, how many of them have a P pattern observed in the sheet of ANA examination?
questions.evidence: total cholesterol is within the normal range refers to `T-CHO` < 250; P pattern observed in the sheet of ANA examination refers to ANA Pattern = 'P';
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.`ANA Pattern` = 'P' AND T2.`T-CHO` < 250

questions.question: For the male patients that have a normal prothrombin time, what is their average prothrombin time?
questions.evidence: male refers to Sex = 'M'; normal prothrombin time refer to PT < 14; average prothrombin time = AVG(PT);
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(T2.PT) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PT < 14 AND T1.SEX = 'M'

questions.question: Please list the event names of all the events attended by Maya Mclean.
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T2.link_to_member = T3.member_id WHERE T3.first_name = 'Maya' AND T3.last_name = 'Mclean'

questions.question: List the full name of all the members of the Student_Club who attended the "Laugh Out Loud" event.
questions.evidence: full name of members refers to first_name, last_name; 'Laugh Out Loud' is an event name;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member INNER JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id WHERE T3.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud'

questions.question: What was the cost for the "Posters" on 2019/9/4?
questions.evidence: 'Poster' is an event description; on 2019/9/14 refers to event_date = '2019-09-04'
questions.SQL: SELECT cost FROM expense WHERE expense_description = 'Posters' AND expense_date = '2019-09-04'

questions.question: Which event has the highest budget amount?
questions.evidence: event refers to event_name; highest budget amount refers to MAX(amount)
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id ORDER BY T1.amount DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which student has been entrusted to manage the budget for the Yearly Kickoff?
questions.evidence: name of students means the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name;'Yearly Kickoff' is an event name;
questions.SQL: SELECT T4.first_name, T4.last_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget INNER JOIN member AS T4 ON T3.link_to_member = T4.member_id WHERE T1.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'

questions.question: Mention the total expense used on 8/20/2019.
questions.evidence: total expense refers SUM(cost) where expense_date = '2019-08-20'
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20'

questions.question: State what kind of expenses that Sacha Harrison incurred?
questions.evidence: kind of expenses refers to expense_description; Sacha Harrison is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name;
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.expense_description FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.first_name = 'Sacha' AND T1.last_name = 'Harrison'

questions.question: List the name and location of events that underspend its budget.
questions.evidence: name of event refers to event_name; underspend its budget refers to remaining > 0
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.event_name, T1.location FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T2.remaining > 0

questions.question: Among the members who incurred expenses in more than one event, who paid the most amount?
questions.evidence: paid the most amount refers to for expense incurred in more than one event refers to MAX(cost where COUNT(event_id) > 1)
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.member_id FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id INNER JOIN budget AS T3 ON T1.link_to_budget = T3.budget_id INNER JOIN event AS T4 ON T3.link_to_event = T4.event_id GROUP BY T2.member_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T4.event_id) > 1 ORDER BY SUM(T1.cost) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Where is the hometown of Garrett Gerke?
questions.evidence: hometown refers to city
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.city FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip WHERE T1.first_name = 'Garrett' AND T1.last_name = 'Gerke'

questions.question: Which student has the hometown of Lincolnton, North Carolina with the zip code of 28092? List their full name and position.
questions.evidence: full name refers to first_name, last_name, hometown of Lincolnton, North Carolina refers to city = 'Lincolnton' AND state = 'North Carolina'
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, T1.position FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T2.zip_code = T1.zip WHERE T2.city = 'Lincolnton' AND T2.state = 'North Carolina' AND T2.zip_code = 28092

questions.question: What was the difference in gas consumption between CZK-paying customers and EUR-paying customers in 2012?
questions.evidence: Year 2012 can be presented as Between 201201 And 201212; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; Difference in Consumption = CZK customers consumption in 2012 - EUR customers consumption in 2012
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(IIF(T1.Currency = 'CZK', T2.Consumption, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T1.Currency = 'EUR', T2.Consumption, 0)) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'

questions.question: What is the average total price of the transactions taken place in gas stations in the Czech Republic?
questions.evidence: Gas station in the Czech Republic implies that Country = 'CZE'
questions.SQL: SELECT AVG(T1.Price) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.Country = 'CZE'

questions.question: What segment did the customer have at 2012/8/23 21:20:00?
questions.evidence: '2012/8/23' can be represented by '2012-08-23'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.Segment FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.date = '2012-08-23' AND T1.time = '21:20:00'

questions.question: For the customer who paid 124.05 in 2012/8/24, how much did he/she spend during the January of 2012? And what is the date and expenses exactly?
questions.evidence: '2012/8/24' can be represented by '2012-08-24'; expense and the consumption has the similar meaning.
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.CustomerID, T2.Date, T2.Consumption FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Price = 124.05 AND T2.Date = '201201'

questions.question: Which country had the gas station that sold the most expensive product id No.2 for one unit?
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.Country FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T1.ProductID = 2 ORDER BY T1.Price DESC LIMIT 1
